ev.q: No potentially life threatening adverse events were reported as of February 24.
One moderate-to-severe adverse event was reported, a suspected case of generalized vaccinia
Among 23 vaccinees with reported other nonserious adverse events
the most common signs and symptoms were fever (n = six), pruritus (n = five)
This report summarizes smallpox vaccine adverse events reported among civilians vaccinated as of February 21, 2003
One other serious adverse event was reported, angina in a man aged 60 years

methods_quotes.q: Potentially life-threatening and moderate-to-serious events are classified on the basis of evidence in support of the reported diagnoses.
Nonserious events are reported through passive surveillance and are expected to be underreported.
